explanation_result.explanation:
+6.7% day-over-day move (z-score 3.15) on 2021-07-20. Reasons given by 4 reports from that day:
- "Arabica coffee gains more than 6 % on frosts in Brazil , sugar rises 2 %" (riotimesonline.com, 2021-07-20). Reported move: up 6.6%. Reason: fears of crop damage after frosts hit production areas of Brazil. Quote: "buoyed by fears of crop damage after frosts hit production areas of major producer Brazil for the second time this year." (source: 0feb2b81893123db)
- "Café arábica avança mais de 6 % com geada no Brasil , acar sobe 2 %" (ricmais.com.br, 2021-07-20). Reported move: up 6%. Reason: geada no Brasil. Quote: "Café arábica avança mais de 6 % com geada no Brasil" (source: 8a986c5849d50c36)
- "Peabirus : Café arábica sobe mais de mil pontos com geada e preocupao com a oferta do Brasil" (redepeabirus.com.br, 2021-07-20). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: geada e preocupação com a oferta do Brasil. Quote: "Café arábica sobe mais de mil pontos com geada e preocupação com a oferta do Brasil" (source: 39a26aa0fd5c7937)
- "Peabirus : Após madrugada com geada , preços do arábica explodem na Bolsa de NY" (redepeabirus.com.br, 2021-07-20). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: geada. Quote: "Após madrugada com geada, preços do arábica explodem na Bolsa de NY" (source: b6fba1d40faa935e)
